verdict.rationale: Algolia lists NeuralSearch as a hosted hybrid keyword and vector semantic search, which implies the platform handles vectorization itself. However, the evidence never explicitly says that Algolia embeds documents and queries for you, or that no user-run embedding pipeline is needed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of built-in or managed embedding of records and queries, details on embedding models and configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use built-in or managed embedders so documents and queries are vectorized without running my own embedding pipeline

citations.quote: AI Search (NeuralSearch) - Hybrid keyword + vector semantic search
Algolia is a search-and-discovery platform providing hosted APIs for full-text
